notes: True for all alpha > 0 (y_i != 0, Psi not identically 0): Duan (arXiv:2608.28376) and Oliveira (arXiv:2609.00336) prove at most 2N-1 critical points (GNS Conjecture 1.9); between consecutive strict local maxima lies an interior minimum, so M maxima need 2M-1 critical points and M <= N. Outside Lean: the cited critical-point theorem and the counting step.
